    CAST(issuing_country = acquirer_country AS INT64) AS is_intra
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`

fees_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
  WHERE (merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(merchant_category_code) = 0)
    AND (monthly_volume IS NULL OR monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
    AND (monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
    AND (capture_delay IS NULL OR capture_delay = '<3')
    AND (account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(account_type) = 0 OR 'R' IN UNNEST(account_type))
)
SELECT DISTINCT f.ID
FROM tx
JOIN fees_f f ON f.card_scheme = tx.card_scheme
WHERE (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = tx.is_credit)
  AND (f.aci IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR tx.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
  AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = tx.is_intra)
ORDER BY f.ID

  SELECT account_type, merchant_category_code, capture_delay FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_data` WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store'
),
tx AS (
  SELECT card_scheme, is_credit, aci, CAST(issuing_country = acquirer_country AS INT64) AS intracountry, eur_amount, has_fraudulent_dispute
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 60 AND 90
),
st AS (
  SELECT SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, 100 * SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fraud_pct FROM tx
),
ctx AS (
  SELECT st.vol, st.fraud_pct, tx.* EXCEPT (eur_amount, has_fraudulent_dispute)
  FROM tx CROSS JOIN st
)
SELECT f.ID, COUNT(*) AS matching_txns, ANY_VALUE(c.vol) AS march_volume_eur, ANY_VALUE(c.fraud_pct) AS march_fraud_pct_volume
FROM ctx c
CROSS JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
CROSS JOIN m
WHERE (f.card_scheme IS NULL OR f.card_scheme = c.card_scheme)
  AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR m.account_type IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
  AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR m.merchant_category_code IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
  AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = c.is_credit)
  AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR c.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
  AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = c.intracountry)
  AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL
       OR (f.capture_delay = '<3' AND CAST(m.capture_delay AS INT64) < 3)
       OR (f.capture_delay = '3-5' AND CAST(m.capture_delay AS INT64) BETWEEN 3 AND 5)
       OR (f.capture_delay = '>5' AND CAST(m.capture_delay AS INT64) > 5))
  AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL
       OR (f.monthly_volume = '<100k' AND c.vol < 100000)
       OR (f.monthly_volume = '100k-1m' AND c.vol >= 100000 AND c.vol <= 1000000)
       OR (f.monthly_volume = '1m-5m' AND c.vol >= 1000000 AND c.vol <= 5000000)
       OR (f.monthly_volume = '>5m' AND c.vol > 5000000))
  AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL
       OR (f.monthly_fraud_level = '<7.2%' AND c.fraud_pct < 7.2)
       OR (f.monthly_fraud_level = '7.2%-7.7%' AND c.fraud_pct >= 7.2 AND c.fraud_pct <= 7.7)
       OR (f.monthly_fraud_level = '7.7%-8.3%' AND c.fraud_pct > 7.7 AND c.fraud_pct <= 8.3)
       OR (f.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%' AND c.fraud_pct > 8.3))
GROUP BY f.ID
ORDER BY f.ID

WITH txn AS (

         CASE WHEN issuing_country = acquirer_country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intra,
         eur_amount, has_fraudulent_dispute
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 60 AND 90
),
vol AS (
  SELECT SUM(eur_amount) AS total_vol,
         100 * SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fraud_pct
  FROM txn
),
bands AS (
  SELECT total_vol, fraud_pct,
    CASE WHEN total_vol < 100000 THEN '<100k'
         WHEN total_vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN total_vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m'
         ELSE '>5m' END AS vband,
    CASE WHEN fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%'
         WHEN fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%'
         ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fband
  FROM vol
)

CROSS JOIN txn t
CROSS JOIN bands b
